title: Der Umschlag
note: Original text written for this benchmark. Not from any published work.

difficult_regions.note: The ellipsis is mid-sentence and must not create a boundary.
Em dashes are parenthetical here, not sentence separators.

The extractor loses the period after 'noch einmal'. A deterministic segmenter CANNOT recover this boundary — expect it to fail here, and expect AI review (A8) to be what fixes it. This document is the regression pin for that claim.
